surge handbook

benchmark.surge.handbook

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Included after actual author, separate source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews of exact approved bindings. Scope means the complete relevant available source documentation/methods actually recorded, with explicit bounded/unread pages, version differences and unknown rights, payload, construction or operations retained. No experiment, settled upstream rights, or human peer review is implied.

Review depth
full source
Disposition
included

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

surge handbook · human annotation: HANDBOOK.md uses ten expert-written base handbooks adapted from industry practice, changes operative policies for each task, and has expert builders construct the world and hand-written rubric before implementing and iterating programmatic checks.

candidate.add17.handbook.construction.v2

  • Policy mutation changes rules and thresholds rather than only cosmetic wording; correct behavior can require withholding an action.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

surge handbook · evaluates: HANDBOOK.md reports the fraction of trials satisfying every criterion, averaging four trials per task, and separately reports a metric allowing one missed criterion and mean criterion scores for analysis.

candidate.add17.handbook.metrics.v2

  • Trials are capped at two hundred tool calls and one hour; provider or transport errors are excluded and rerun rather than counted as task failures.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

surge handbook · dataset size: HANDBOOK.md’s v3 paper defines sixty-five tasks in ten fictional companies across five enterprise domains, with a containerized workspace, seeded mock services, work request and programmatic rubric for each task.

candidate.add17.handbook.units.v2

  • Simulated email, Slack, calendar, Jira andShopify services are benchmark fixtures; they are not evidence of live changes to real company systems.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

surge handbook · evaluates: HANDBOOK.md’s v3 paper specifies 824 deterministic criteria:592 required-output checks and 232 prohibited-behavior checks over final files and service states, without LLM judging.

candidate.add17.handbook.verification.v2

  • Exact-count invariants also check that actions outside the task scope were not performed; counts describe the documented release rather than an independent payload recount.
